$comment: MA-008, section 4. The One Thing: each rule reads one list from the gathered facts, keeps the rows that pass every `where` clause, picks one by `pick` (max or min of a field), and says it with `say` (fields in braces). `rank` orders the survivors; the report prints the top three. Ops: gte, gt, lte, lt, eq, ne, between. A rule with `needs` skips itself, silently, when that source did not answer.
